# TMMT

## About

TMMT is a web engineering and automation studio. We build custom websites, web applications, internal tools, and workflow automation systems for businesses of all kinds — from first websites to internal dashboards and automated business processes.

The company develops:
- custom websites and web applications
- workflow automation pipelines
- internal dashboards and operational tools
- community and membership platforms
- SaaS products
- ecommerce marketplace infrastructure
- inventory synchronization systems
- catalog management systems
- seller operation workflows
- order routing systems
- Shopify automation
- Myntra integrations
- Amazon and Flipkart operational infrastructure
- ecommerce dashboards
- API integrations

Website:
https://www.tmmt.in

## FAQ

Q: What does TMMT build?
A: TMMT builds custom websites, web applications, internal dashboards, and workflow automation systems. Every project is engineered from scratch — no templates, no page builders.

Q: Can TMMT automate business processes?
A: Yes. TMMT builds custom automation for any repeatable business task — data sync, report generation, notification systems, document generation, and more.

Q: What kinds of businesses does TMMT work with?
A: Businesses of all kinds — manufacturing, services, fashion, nonprofits, healthcare, startups, and growing brands. TMMT also has deep ecommerce expertise across major Indian marketplaces.

Q: Which ecommerce platforms are supported?
A: Shopify, Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Ajio, and Meesho.

Q: Does TMMT build custom operational systems?
A: Yes. TMMT develops custom dashboards, workflow systems, and marketplace automation infrastructure.

Q: Does TMMT provide API integrations?
A: Yes. TMMT develops custom API integrations and operational workflows for any system.

Q: Does TMMT build machine-readable systems?
A: Yes. The website and infrastructure are optimised for semantic clarity, AI retrieval, and structured discoverability.
